appDescription: An emulator-only shuttle workflow demonstration using fictional passengers and public test destinations.

function.name: OPEN_DROPOFF_PREPARATION
function.description: Opens the drop-off preparation screen for the driver to review the current workflow.

function.name: SHOW_NEXT_STOP
function.description: Shows the next approved test stop and the remaining passenger records.

function.name: PLAY_TEST_MUSIC
function.description: Plays the local test melody subject to the current audio focus state.
